description: Test suite for error handling utilities related to MS Teams integration, covering error classification, formatting, and proxy revocation handling.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Main test suite grouping error handling tests.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Assertion function for verifying test expectations.

methods.name: vi.fn
methods.description: Creates mock functions for tracing calls.

methods.name: classifyMSTeamsSendError
methods.description: Classifies errors based on MS Teams send error response.

methods.name: formatMSTeamsSendErrorHint
methods.description: Provides hints based on error classification for user guidance.

methods.name: formatUnknownError
methods.description: Formats unknown or null errors into string messages.

methods.name: isRevokedProxyError
methods.description: Detects if a TypeError is caused by a revoked proxy.

methods.name: withRevokedProxyFallback
methods.description: Executes a function with fallback logic when a revoked proxy error occurs.

calls: expect(classifyMSTeamsSendError({ statusCode: 403, response: { body: { error: { code: "ContentStreamNotAllowed" } } } })).toMatchObject({ kind: "permanent", statusCode: 403, errorCode: "ContentStreamNotAllowed" })
expect(classifyMSTeamsSendError({ statusCode: 429, retryAfter: "1.5" })).toMatchObject({ kind: "throttled", statusCode: 429, retryAfterMs: 1500 })
expect(formatMSTeamsSendErrorHint({ kind: "permanent", errorCode: "ContentStreamNotAllowed" })).toContain("expired the content stream")
expect(isRevokedProxyError(new TypeError("Cannot perform 'set' on a proxy that has been revoked"))).toBe(true)
expect(isRevokedProxyError(new Error("proxy that has been revoked"))).toBe(false)
expect(isRevokedProxyError(new TypeError("undefined is not a function"))).toBe(false)
withRevokedProxyFallback({ run: async () => { throw new TypeError("Cannot perform 'get' on a proxy that has been revoked") }, onRevoked: async () => "fallback", onRevokedLog })
withRevokedProxyFallback({ run: async () => { throw err }, onRevoked: async () => "fallback" })
